lines.text: He rage quit after he lost.

data.define: To stop playing suddenly because you are upset.

example.text: He rage quit after he lost.

misuse.text: Don't 'rage quit' a team meeting online.
misuse.why: It leaves colleagues confused and annoyed.

publish.title: What does "rage quit" mean?
publish.value: Rage quit = Leave a game in anger. Example: "He rage quit after he lost." (casual English).
